thread:
Marta: Quick sync — webinar scheduled for May 14. Goal: move seed users to first API call. Need microcopy, 3 prompt template packs, and a 3-credit starter pack. Who can own which piece?
Sam: I'm in. Proposed flow: webinar -> prompt pack unlocked -> 3 free credits that expire in 7 days. A/B test CTA 'Try a sample prompt' vs 'Start your integration'.
Dinesh: Sounds good. Can we add a +24h onboarding nudge email with a one-click 'Run sample' button and an example prompt?
Priya: Question on activation metric: do we define activation as "first generation > 10 tokens" or "first successful API key creation + call"? leaning to API call but want clarity for routing.
Alex: We can tag folks client-side: event 'webinar_attended' then 'credits_redeemed'. Routing rule suggestion: webinar_attended + credits_redeemed + usage > 100 tokens in 72h => set trait should_notify_sales=true.
Marta: @Alex is that implementable by EOD Wed? Also we need 3 vertical prompt packs: support bot, content summarizer, code assistant — keep them very short (3 examples each).
Sam: I'll draft the 3 prompt packs. Also propose a prompt UX test: 'guided prompt with fill-in fields' vs 'blank editor + examples' to see which drives more runs.
Priya: Copy note: use CTA copy 'Redeem starter credits' (not generic 'Get started'). A/B primary metric = redemption rate, secondary = 72h usage. Please include microcopy about credit expiration.
Dinesh: Ops ask: reserve dedicated quota for webinar traffic to avoid throttling spike. @eng-sre can you confirm quota config and an emergency fallback?
marketing-bot: Promo created: code WEBINAR_MAY14, cap 1k redemptions, daily token cap 100k. Analytics event hooks deployed to /events/promo_redeem.
Marta: Next steps: Sam -> prompt drafts by Tue EOD; Alex -> routing tag + feature flag by Wed; Priya -> measurement spec by Thu; Dinesh -> quota confirmation + runbook by Thu. Quick sync Fri 11am. :thumbsup:
